    """Extend a diagonal run of 7s in its existing direction."""
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    bg = max(set(v for row in grid for v in row), key=lambda v: sum(r.count(v) for r in grid))
    pts = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] == 7]
    if len(pts) < 2:
        return out
    # The two 7s define the diagonal direction; extend from the endpoint.
    dr = pts[-1][0] - pts[0][0]
    dc = pts[-1][1] - pts[0][1]
    if dr == 0 or dc == 0:
        return out
    dr = 1 if dr > 0 else -1
    dc = 1 if dc > 0 else -1
    # Choose the 7 endpoint from which the line advances toward the grid edge.
    # For an increasing-row direction, use the greatest row; otherwise least row.
    end = max(pts, key=lambda p: p[0]) if dr > 0 else min(pts, key=lambda p: p[0])
    r, c = end[0] + dr, end[1] + dc
    while 0 <= r < h and 0 <= c < w and grid[r][c] == bg:
        out[r][c] = 7
        r += dr
        c += dc
    return out

Descriptions should name the tasks that need the skill, covering distinct branches without repeating synonyms. Prefer fixing an unclear reference over duplicating its content.
